title: Fetchlinks RSS fetch observation (contract v1)
description: The outcome of one attempt to fetch one RSS feed. Health counters are derived by the publisher and never carried here, so replaying a batch cannot inflate them.

normalized_url.description: Natural key joining this observation to the feed catalog.

feed_url.description: Feed URL as configured, before normalization.

success.description: True when the feed was fetched successfully or confirmed unchanged.

status.description: HTTP status code, or null when the request never produced one.

latest_entry_at.description: Timestamp of the newest entry seen in this feed, or null when unknown.

site_link.description: Website the feed advertises, used as the public-facing source link.
